photo.caption: Bronze plate for printing an advertisement for the Liu family needle shop at Jinan, Song dynasty China. It is considered the world's earliest identified printed advertising medium.
photo.description: Bronze plate for printing an advertisement for the Liu family needle shop at Jinan. Song Dynasty (960-1279). This is the earliest extant example of a commercial advertisement.
